call_points.text: Total projects on hand are ₹2,800 Cr, with about ₹1,500 Cr more to be spent over the next two years.
Weak nitric acid plant is about three months delayed, which management says will be recouped; AMUGL and AN Melt are online.
TGU production is expected at broadly last year's level; TGU was one of the significant contributors to Q1 profit.
Cash on hand is around ₹4,000 Cr, held across G-Sec, GSFS and bank deposits.
Oil and gas prices rose in Q1 on the Middle East crisis and remain volatile; gas availability is a concern though operations are unaffected.
Management declined to give Q2 realisation guidance, citing a volatile market, and said it has never given such guidance.
GNFC proposed an MoU with GMDC for underground coal gasification; studies are ongoing and an announcement is expected soon.
Brownfield capex of Weak Nitric Acid, Ammonium Nitrate and Ammonia expansion totaling ~₹2,100 crores is on track.
Coal-based CCPP expected to generate savings of ₹10-12 crores per month once operational.
Brownfield capex of Weak Nitric Acid, Ammonium Nitrate and Ammonia expansion totaling ~₹2,100 crores is largely on track.
Dahej power and steam plant is expected to commence operations by Q-2 FY 26-27.
